description: Full config inline on purpose: this repo does not extend a preset owned by another account, so its bot behaviour changes only through a reviewed PR here.
Scope mirrors the Dependabot config this replaces: the Python project (pyproject.toml exact pins + uv.lock) and GitHub Actions. Lab image digests are handled by update-discovery.yml, not Renovate.
Never automerge (CONTRIBUTING.md, GOVERNANCE.md). Every commit carries a DCO sign-off matching Renovate's git author.
Digest/pin updates carry no upstream release date; the release-age wait applies to version updates only.
scripts/check_workflows.py fixes runners to ubuntu-24.04/ubuntu-latest and the Python matrix to 3.12/3.13: never propose runner or setup-action tool-version bumps.
One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps (same as Dependabot's github-actions group). Each needs the matching TRUSTED_ACTIONS edit in scripts/check_workflows.py before CI passes.
Development dependencies in one PR (same as Dependabot's controller-development group). requirements-dev.lock and requirements-runtime.lock must be re-exported from uv.lock by hand (CONTRIBUTING.md).
Majors stay one PR per dependency.
